methodologyNotes: The roster covers nine home humidifiers spanning ultrasonic, evaporative, and dual-mist categories; one requested model (Dreo Macro Pro) is an air purifier with no humidifier variant and was replaced by the Dreo HM713S, Dreo's flagship smart warm-and-cool-mist humidifier. Specifications were drawn from manufacturer product pages (Levoit/VeSync, Vornado, Carepod, Canopy, Pure Enrichment, Govee, Dreo, Honeywell store) and corroborated by independent reviewer measurements (Live Science, Air Smartly, TechWalls, MashTips, PRNewswire). Tank capacity is in liters; coverage is the manufacturer-stated maximum in square feet; runtime_hours reflects the low-mist or typical runtime from a full tank; noise_dba is the manufacturer-stated or reviewer-measured value on the lowest standard operating speed (null where no credible value was found); smart_wifi and top_fill are booleans (true = yes). Adversarial re-verification (2026-06-15) confirmed every product exists, every priceUsd matches an official US product page, and every source/corroboration URL is live and topical. No products were removed and no headline specs required correction.
